sign.read: Nothing it can tell me that it has not already said.
oil-can.look: A can of lamp oil, a little rusty.
door.look: A weathered door into the lighthouse.
door-out.look: The door back to the dock.
keeper.look: A weathered old man in a heavy coat. The lighthouse keeper, I assume.
stairs.look: A spiral staircase winds up towards the lamp room.
stairs.blocked: The keeper steps in front of the stairs. "Not before we have talked, stranger."
window.look: The sea is black and empty tonight.
lamp.look.first: The great lamp, cold and dark. No wonder the ships keep getting lost out there.
lamp.look: The great lamp is cold and dark.
lamp.cold: It will not light by itself. It needs oil and a flame.
lamp.glows: The lamp glows warm and bright.
lamp.filled: I pour the oil into the lamp.
lamp.already-filled: It is already full of oil.
lamp.nothing-to-burn: There is nothing to burn yet. The lamp is empty.
lamp.lit: The flame catches, and the great lamp roars to life.
ending.boat: Far out on the dark water, a ship turns towards the light.
